**Make Gemini feel like ChatGPT. Change the UI, not the AI.**

## Install (no coding needed)

1. Download **`GeminiFX-extension.zip`** below. ⚠️ Not "Source code (zip)": that one is for developers.
2. Right-click the zip → **Extract All**. You get a folder that contains `manifest.json`.
3. Open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked**, and select that folder.
4. Open or refresh [gemini.google.com](https://gemini.google.com).

**Updating:** download the new zip, replace the folder's contents, then click ⟳ on the GeminiFX card.

Changes in this version: see [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/xyzbuddy/GeminiFX/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
